plan: Job listings gathered from open boards with their provenance, search and saved searches; the agent pillar comes next.
summary: OpenVibe.Work gathers job listings from three public job boards (Arbeitnow, Remotive, RemoteOK) under their terms — the source is named and the original listing is linked on every page, and only a short excerpt is kept. It searches them with facets, shows one listing with a schema.org JobPosting whose url is the original, and lets a signed-in person keep a search and see what is new since they last looked. Public reads need no token.
works: The ingest: three boards read on a timer (WORK_INGEST=on, off in tests and development), each with its own User-Agent, 15-second timeout, upsert by (source, source_id) and expiry after 30 days unseen
The listings: provenance kept and shown (source name, link to the original, when it was fetched), a short plain-text excerpt, never the full description
Search: /jobs?q=&remote=&type=&location= newest first, 30 a page with a cursor, facets for remote and job type
One listing: /jobs/:id with the board's fields, the excerpt, a 'Read the full listing on <source>' link and a JobPosting JSON-LD whose url is the original
Saved searches for a signed-in person, each with the count of listings new since they last looked; /saved is where that count is cleared
The API (/api/v1): jobs, one job, sources with their terms and last fetch, and saved searches
The pages: home, /jobs, /jobs/:id, /saved, /sources, /docs and /updates — server-rendered, complete without JavaScript
Discovery: a sitemap carrying the newest listings, llms.txt, robots.txt (saved searches excluded) and JSON-LD
Per-caller limits on the search and on saved-search writes; problem+json errors with stable codes
Tests: the ingest, the search, the pages and the saved searches against stand-in boards, on a temp PGlite database with a mock Network

Account export and deletion (ADR-033): the searches a person saved are exported to OpenVibe.Network on network.account.export_requested and deleted whole on network.account.deleted, with the counts confirmed back; the two Events topics are subscribed at boot (server/identity/account-data.js)
notYet: The agent pillar: drafting, tailoring and tracking an application with the person's approval at each step
Alerts: being told when a listing that fits appears — that comes through OpenVibe.Watch with the agent pillar; today a saved search is a repeatable search plus a count of what is new
Its service and capability manifests in openvibe-contracts (contracts-service is work): the API is live, but no <work>.jobs.* capability is registered yet, so app and agent tokens cannot call it
A deployment: the service is not registered with OpenVibe.Services nor deployed by OpenVibe.Host
deployment: openvibe-ovh: unit openvibe-work.service on 127.0.0.1:4960 (git checkout /opt/openvibe.work, env /etc/openvibe/work.env, database ov_work), deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy work`; public at https://openvibe.work since 2026-10-08.
